questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: English speaking country and awesome nature

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Det var ret svært for at være ærlig, jeg skulle til Australien så hvis man skrev til nogen (email el lign) kan man godt forvente en svartid på 2+ dage pga tidsforskel

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: UTS havde deres egen student services der var rigtig søde da jeg ville skifte kurser osv. Derudover var der orientation events man kunne melde sig til

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: UTS har et kollegie der er forbundet campus. Jeg boede i en 6 share apartment så havde fem roomates med køkken og stue hvor alle har privat værelse. Derudover ku man få private rooms eller two shares for en højere husleje.

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: Der var et fint køkken

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Sørg for at være der i introugen hvor alle andre internationale studerende er ligeså desperate for venner som dig! Der kan man hurtigt finde sig et crew. 5

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Bare læs de mails du får og læs det HELE og husk dine deadlines. Det var min største udfordring. Derudover er der noget med conflicting deadlines osv, ting man ikek kan søge før man har visa, insureance osv.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Man kan altid skrive til dem, men forvent lange svartider

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg søgte 8 classes og kom ind på fire. To af dem endte med at være første års kemikurser, og som 3 års kemiker var jeg ikke så interesseret i at følge dem, så i drop and add perioden endte jeg med at droppe dem og tage et 15etcs forskningsprojekt med en lokal proffessor istedet.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Det var sygt fedt at lave projekt, men vidste ikke før jeg kom ned det var en mulighed. Helt sikkert undersøg om det er noget for dig!

Additional comments:

questions.answer: BA

questions.answer: BA

questions.answer: Det var ret svært at finde ud af hvilket niveau det enkelte kurser var, men man kan finde course plans online for studier.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Meget det samme, men flere rapporter/afleveringer der gælder point til din endelige grade + midterms.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester
